<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Move LEFT toward green blocks at same row level (rows 37-41)
# Player at col 44-45, green blocks at col 25-29, 19-23, 13-17
# Need to move left about 3-4 steps

for i in range(4):
    result = action(['LEFT'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    player = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b'][0]
    pc = [p[1] for p in player['boundary']]
    pr = [p[0] for p in player['boundary']]
    print(f"LEFT #{i+1}: player cols {min(pc)}-{max(pc)}, rows {min(pr)}-{max(pr)}, level={result.get('level_completed')}")
    if result.get('level_completed'):
        break

# Check adjacency to green blocks
seg = current_frame.segmentation
player = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b'][0]
greens = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
adj = seg['adjacency_list']

print(f"\nPlayer adjacencies:")
for a, b in adj:
    if a == player['id'] or b == player['id']:
        other_id = b if a == player['id'] else a
        other = seg['nodes'][other_id]
        print(f"  Adjacent to {other['color']} (id={other_id})")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
